en.headline: Six bids received for inaugural land tender at Hong Kong-Shenzhen Innovation and…
en.dek: Loop Hong Kong Park Company said the response for four parcels totalling more than 76,000 square metres of gross floor area exceeded expectations after the tender closed on Monday.
body: The operator of the Hong Kong-Shenzhen Innovation and Technology Park received six bids for its first land tender by the Monday deadline, Loop Hong Kong Park Company said.

The four parcels, earmarked for innovation and technology uses and talent accommodation, have a combined gross floor area exceeding 76,000 square metres. The company described the response as enthusiastic and said it reflected industry recognition of Hong Kong’s strengths in innovation and technology as well as confidence in the park’s development.

The tender follows the recent award of a large-scale land disposal pilot project at Hung Shui Kiu in the Northern Metropolis. Loop Hong Kong Park Company said the bidders included high-end innovation and technology firms and large conglomerates.

zh.headline: 港深創新及科技園首批地皮招標接獲六份標書
zh.dek: 落馬洲河套港方園區營運商表示，四幅合共樓面逾7.6萬平方米的地皮周一截標，反應較預期理想。
body: 港深創新及科技園營運商Loop Hong Kong Park Company表示，園區首批土地招標於周一截止，共接獲六份標書。
四幅地皮指定作創科及人才住宿用途，合共樓面面積超過7.6萬平方米。公司形容反應踴躍，反映業界對香港創科優勢及園區發展的信心。
是次招標緊接北部都會區洪水橋大面積土地處置先導項目批出之後。公司指投標者包括高端創科企業及大型企業集團。
